description.html: This 80x50x50 cm terrarium (200 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

The horizontal layout with 80 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. This layout is key for reptiles because it lets them choose the temperature they are exposed to. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

The terrarium is ordered with your choice of film and background. For non-standard requests (other dimensions, double sliding glass panels, a built-in thermostat), write to us or call. Free consultations and delivery to all cities.
